dedupe_keys.name: kenya electricity transmission network and generation expansion analysis using opentepes inputs and results

description: This data set holds the complete openTEPES input and result files for an analysis of Kenya's electricity transmission network and generation expansion for 2030, 2040 and 2050. It was published on Zenodo in September 2026 by Joseph Obbo, Julius Butime, Victor Rop and Daniel Simiyu. The analysis identifies the investment needed in transmission and generation to meet expected demand while maintaining what the authors call ecosystem harmony, extending the country's Vision 2030 and 2060 goals. Because openTEPES inputs describe the network, generators, storage, demand and scenario data, the package gives an open, model-ready representation of the Kenyan power system that others can rerun or modify, along with the published results. Coverage is Kenya. Files are two ZIP archives, inputs of about 27 MB and results of about 70 MB, downloadable from Zenodo under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. Caveats: the abstract is brief, sources of the input data are not listed on the page read, and the analysis is a single study's set of assumptions. Simulation uses are national transmission and generation expansion planning and scenario comparison for Kenya. Related records: model-opentepes is the model used.
